gaps.sentence: He ___ denied knowing anything about the plan (FIRM).
gaps.explanation: An adverb modifies the verb 'denied': firmly. Note the doubled m before -ly.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (SURVIVE) of the species is under threat.
gaps.explanation: The noun from SURVIVE is 'survival'; a survivor is a person.

gaps.sentence: The success of the launch rests on the ___ (RELY) of the supplier.
gaps.explanation: 'The reliability of the supplier' — the quality noun is needed after 'the'.

gaps.sentence: The new bypass will be ___ (BENEFIT) to thousands of commuters.
gaps.explanation: 'Be beneficial to' — the adjective follows the verb 'be'.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (IDENTIFY) of the body took weeks.
gaps.hint: noun: the act of establishing who
gaps.explanation: 'The identification of the body' — the process noun is required.

gaps.sentence: We need ___ proof before we can act (CONCLUDE).
gaps.explanation: An adjective is needed before 'proof': conclusive (-ive). 'Conclusion' is the noun.

gaps.sentence: We ___ the cost of the trip and ran out of money (ESTIMATE).
gaps.hint: judged it too low — that is why the money ran out (under-)
gaps.explanation: Running out of money shows the estimate was too low: underestimated (under- + estimated).

gaps.sentence: The meeting has been ___ until Thursday (SCHEDULE).
gaps.hint: arranged for a new time (re-); past participle needed
gaps.explanation: The prefix re- means again/afresh: rescheduled means given a new time. The passive needs the past participle.
